client_fields_valid.name: client_fields_valid
client_fields_valid.value: length(btrim("clients"."name")) between 2 and 120 and "clients"."version">0 and ("clients"."phone" is null or "clients"."phone" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$')

cost_entry_nonnegative.name: cost_entry_nonnegative
cost_entry_nonnegative.value: ("inventory_cost_entries"."before_usd" is null or "inventory_cost_entries"."before_usd">=0) and ("inventory_cost_entries"."after_usd" is null or "inventory_cost_entries"."after_usd">=0)

fraction_conservation.name: fraction_conservation
fraction_conservation.value: "inventory_movements"."kind"<>'fraction' or ("inventory_movements"."counted_before" is not null and "inventory_movements"."delivered_pieces" is not null and "inventory_movements"."remaining_pieces" is not null and "inventory_movements"."counted_before">0 and "inventory_movements"."delivered_pieces">=0 and "inventory_movements"."remaining_pieces">=0 and "inventory_movements"."counted_before"="inventory_movements"."delivered_pieces"+"inventory_movements"."remaining_pieces")

lots_values_valid.name: lots_values_valid
lots_values_valid.value: ("lots"."blisters_per_box_snapshot" is null or "lots"."blisters_per_box_snapshot" between 1 and 100) and "lots"."unit_cost_usd">=0 and "lots"."packing_rule_version">0

lot_commercial_unit_valid.name: lot_commercial_unit_valid
lot_commercial_unit_valid.value: "lots"."commercial_unit_label_snapshot" is null or (length(btrim("lots"."commercial_unit_label_snapshot")) between 1 and 80 and "lots"."packing_model_snapshot"='whole' and "lots"."box_weight_kg_snapshot" is null)

packing_mode_valid.name: packing_mode_valid
packing_mode_valid.value: "packing_rules"."packing_model" in ('blister','halves','whole') and "packing_rules"."half_preparation" in ('counted','commercial','pending','none') and "packing_rules"."confirmation_status" in ('confirmed','pending') and ("packing_rules"."box_weight_kg" is null or "packing_rules"."box_weight_kg">0)

packing_presentations_valid.name: packing_presentations_valid
packing_presentations_valid.value: "packing_rules"."allowed_presentations" <@ ARRAY['box','half_box','blister']::text[] and 'box'=any("packing_rules"."allowed_presentations") and cardinality("packing_rules"."allowed_presentations") between 1 and 3 and ("packing_rules"."packing_model"='blister' or "packing_rules"."blisters_per_box" is null) and ("packing_rules"."packing_model"<>'whole' or ("packing_rules"."allowed_presentations"=ARRAY['box']::text[] and "packing_rules"."half_preparation"='none')) and ("packing_rules"."packing_model"<>'halves' or (not ('blister'=any("packing_rules"."allowed_presentations")) and "packing_rules"."half_preparation"='commercial'))

packing_commercial_unit_valid.name: packing_commercial_unit_valid
packing_commercial_unit_valid.value: "packing_rules"."commercial_unit_label" is null or (length(btrim("packing_rules"."commercial_unit_label")) between 1 and 80 and "packing_rules"."packing_model"='whole' and "packing_rules"."box_weight_kg" is null)

payment_currency_rate.name: payment_currency_rate
payment_currency_rate.value: ("payments"."currency" in ('USD','USDT') and "payments"."bcv_rate_id" is null and "payments"."usdt_rate_id" is null and "payments"."amount"="payments"."amount_usd") or ("payments"."currency"='VES' and (("payments"."bcv_rate_id" is not null and "payments"."usdt_rate_id" is null) or ("payments"."bcv_rate_id" is null and "payments"."usdt_rate_id" is not null)))

sale_manual_price_valid.name: sale_manual_price_valid
sale_manual_price_valid.value: ("sale_lines"."price_basis"='manual' and "sale_lines"."reference_unit_usd" is null and "sale_lines"."agreed_unit_usd">0) or ("sale_lines"."price_basis"<>'manual' and "sale_lines"."reference_unit_usd" is not null)

sale_commercial_unit_valid.name: sale_commercial_unit_valid
sale_commercial_unit_valid.value: "sale_lines"."commercial_unit_label_snapshot" is null or (length(btrim("sale_lines"."commercial_unit_label_snapshot")) between 1 and 80 and "sale_lines"."presentation"='box')

usdt_quote_valid.name: usdt_quote_valid
usdt_quote_valid.value: "usdt_rates"."source"='BINANCE_P2P_BUY' and "usdt_rates"."rate">0 and "usdt_rates"."valid_until">"usdt_rates"."valid_from" and "usdt_rates"."valid_until"<="usdt_rates"."valid_from"+interval '15 minutes' and "usdt_rates"."verified_at">="usdt_rates"."fetched_at" and "usdt_rates"."source_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "usdt_rates"."source_url"='https://www.binance.com/bapi/c2c/v1/public/c2c/agent/quote-price?fiat=VES&asset=USDT&tradeType=BUY'

push_active_keys.name: push_active_keys
push_active_keys.value: not "push_devices"."active" or ("push_devices"."endpoint" is not null and "push_devices"."p256dh" is not null and "push_devices"."auth" is not null)

public.receivables.definition:
SELECT s.id AS sale_id,s.client_id,s.number,CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN s.due_date ELSE d.due_date END AS due_date,
  'USD'::text AS currency,s.total_usd,coalesce(p.paid,0)::numeric(18,2) AS paid_usd,(s.total_usd-coalesce(p.paid,0))::numeric(18,2) AS balance_usd
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT id,due_date FROM sale_date_events WHERE sale_id=s.id ORDER BY event_order DESC LIMIT 1)d ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT sum(a.amount_usd) AS paid FROM payment_applications a WHERE a.sale_id=s.id
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_reversals r WHERE r.payment_id=a.payment_id))p ON true
WHERE s.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sale_cancellations c WHERE c.sale_id=s.id)
public.receivables.name: receivables
